context.gh_issue_title: [BUG] GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup pre-flight blocks zig build bench on fresh/main
context.gh_issue_body_summary: GBL-116 has a PRE-FLIGHT GATE that RAISE EXCEPTIONs unless every tenant in public.tenant has a tenant_schemas row with migrations_applied_at IS NOT NULL AND at least one tnt05_progress row with status='COMPLETED'. On a fresh bench DB (or any DB where the default tenant was not provisioned through the TNT-05 backfill path), the gate aborts with 'TNT-07 pre-flight failed: tnt05_progress table does not exist. Run GBL-074 and GBL-075 first.' or 'TNT-07 pre-flight failed. Unready tenants: ...'. Discovered during WF02-plc-batch-b-20260815 Step 05 RELEASE-VALIDATOR (NFR gate) and Step 06 DOC-UPDATER. git diff origin/main...HEAD -- migrations/GBL-116* is empty — pure inheritance from main. NFR gate was carried forward using the last good metrics (sol-batch1, commit 99ad43db). Blocks `zig build bench` (NFR performance gate) on main until resolved. Does NOT block Fresh-database CI migration bootstrap (which passes 146/146). Three candidate fixes: (a) make the bench DB provisioning path run GBL-074/GBL-075 + TNT-05 backfill before GBL-116; (b) relax the pre-flight gate for the bench seed tenant; (c) document/script a bench-specific migrate path that satisfies the gate.
context.gh_ack_comment_template: Acknowledged — this bug is now being worked as workflow **WF03-GH791-20260815** (ISS-0706 in the local registry). Root cause is confirmed: GBL-116's pre-flight gate aborts on fresh bench DB because the default tenant has no tenant_schemas row with migrations_applied_at IS NOT NULL and no tnt05_progress row with status='COMPLETED'. Will be root-caused, fixed, and merged via PR. Tracking: docs/issues/ISS-0706.json.
